title: Each domain has a short file an agent reads for its task.
description: Serves delivery within the owner's usage limit (D-151) and binds JS-216 onward to the domains. No dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/domains/ holds one file per domain of the accepted map plus platform.md, each under 6 KB, with its words, what it owns, what it must not do, and its new rules (68 to 76 as decided here).
DOMAINS.md opens with the map and the new rules.
AGENTS.md gains a table from each domain to the files a task touching it reads, and the build workflow gives a task's agents only its domains' files.
No existing invariant moves or changes.
notes: Phase OPS chosen (sibling JS-093, OPS); ux flag left unset.
